name: Intrepid Settler
text: **Intrepid Settler**: Some gnomes add to the thrill of living by settling in precarious places such as the flotsam of Gogpodda or the treehouses of Omesta. These intrepid gnomes gain a +2 racial bonus on saving throws against fear effects and on Acrobatics, Climb, and Swim checks. This racial trait replaces illusion resistance, keen senses, and obsessive.
